about.question: What is MboaGo?
about.answer: MboaGo is an app for travelling and enjoying life in Cameroon. It brings together bus trips, hotels and rooms, activities and your tickets. Explore gives you ideas, your profile holds your memories, and groups bring your travel and activity companions together. The app is currently in development.

available.question: Is the app available yet?
available.answer: MboaGo is being prepared for iOS and Android. Official download links will be added here when it launches on the App Store and Google Play.

destinations.question: Which destinations can I explore?
destinations.answer: The preview features Douala, Yaoundé, Kribi, Buéa, Limbé and Bafoussam. Available routes, accommodation and activities will be listed in the app at launch.

booking.question: How will booking work?
booking.answer: Choose a trip and a seat, a hotel and a room, or an activity and a time slot. Review the details, then find your bookings in “My tickets”. The previews on this page are illustrative and do not allow real bookings.

payment.question: Which payment methods are planned?
payment.answer: MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money and bank cards are planned. Availability will be confirmed at launch. No payments are made or collected on this website.
